nudges.three:
A little quiz.
A sweet treat?

QUIZ-01.explanation: It’s “oh cool.” Like your reaction when your AI teammate gets work done right and fast.

QUIZ-02.explanation: Eight petals around an open middle. It’s a flower, not a gear in costume.

options.C: Petals? Isn’t it just a circle?

QUIZ-02.text: How many petals does Okou’s flower symbol have?

QUIZ-03.explanation: Zero is taking a well-earned break. Okou is here to carry the work forward.
QUIZ-03.text: Before Okou took over, who was on the team?

QUIZ-04.explanation: Come on—research, decks, websites… it’s got more than one trick up its sleeve.
QUIZ-04.text: Halloween or not, what’s Okou’s real job?

QUIZ-05.explanation: Tell Okou what you want, get what you need. It puts your connected tools to work.

options.B: Plans the steps and gets to work

QUIZ-05.text: Give Okou a job. What does it do?

QUIZ-06.explanation: More done. Same team. Less busywork.
QUIZ-06.text: What’s Okou’s motto for a team buried in work?

QUIZ-07.explanation: Brief Okou in plain language. Simple as that—no AI expertise needed.

options.B: [Okou is out of the office. Back after Halloween.]

QUIZ-07.text: Do you need to code to brief Okou?

QUIZ-08.explanation: Your laptop can rest. Okou’s work runs in the cloud.

options.B: Nooo—it can keep working in the cloud

QUIZ-08.text: Does Okou “fall asleep” when you close your laptop?

QUIZ-09.explanation: Another task? Bring it on. Okou can go waaaaay beyond that.

options.A: Of course—tasks can run in parallel

QUIZ-09.text: A long research job is running. Can Okou take another task?

QUIZ-10.explanation: Earlier messages, results, and corrections stay in context. Less retelling of the same story.
QUIZ-10.text: Why refine a spooky brief in the same Okou chat?

QUIZ-11.explanation: Same hat, same job. Shared instructions keep everyone on the same page.
QUIZ-11.text: What does a shared Okou agent give your team?

QUIZ-12.explanation: Save the reviewed method as a Workflow—a reusable SOP your team can run again.

options.A: Save it as an Okou Workflow

QUIZ-12.text: A process worked like magic. How do you make it reusable?

QUIZ-13.explanation: Tell Okou when it should run. It sets up the trigger—no scheduling code needed.

options.B: Set an alarm and run it yourself
options.C: Just ask Okou to set it up

QUIZ-13.text: What’s the easiest way to automate an Okou workflow?

QUIZ-14.explanation: Describe it, review the proposed steps, then save the version you agree on.

options.A: Build it all in a flowchart
options.B: Tell Okou the steps in plain language
options.C: Book a meeting with IT first

QUIZ-14.text: What’s the easiest way to build a workflow with Okou?

QUIZ-15.explanation: Set it once. Okou runs the workflow automatically—no need to “summon” it every time.
QUIZ-15.text: You write a report every Monday morning. How can Okou help?

QUIZ-16.explanation: Emails, calendar events, or a finished run can start a configured workflow.

options.A: Adding URGENT to the workflow name
options.C: A matching email in a connected inbox

QUIZ-16.text: Besides a schedule, what can wake an Okou Automation?

QUIZ-17.explanation: Save the fix once. Anyone with access to the workflow can use the updated version.

options.B: Anyone with access to the workflow

QUIZ-17.text: You save a fix to a shared Okou workflow. Who can use it?

QUIZ-18.explanation: The run stops and keeps its log, so you can see which step went wrong.

options.C: No idea… maybe a retry will work?

QUIZ-18.text: An Okou automation fails. What record can you check?

QUIZ-19.explanation: Decks, websites, images, and files—all in one place: Artifacts.
QUIZ-19.text: Which Okou section keeps your finished creations together?

QUIZ-20.explanation: The blank deck is history. Okou is your all-around AI teammate.

options.C: Only tips for making it yourself

QUIZ-20.text: Ask Okou for a Halloween pitch deck. What can it build?

QUIZ-21.explanation: An editable PowerPoint deck? Okou won’t let you down.
QUIZ-21.text: What can Okou export your Halloween deck as?

QUIZ-22.explanation: Private by default. Use Share to choose who gets access.
QUIZ-22.text: Who can see your new private Okou files by default?

QUIZ-23.explanation: Upload the image. Okou will rebuild it as an editable slide. Then revise it in chat.
QUIZ-23.text: A slide image has too much text. Easiest fix?

QUIZ-24.explanation: Send Okou your brand file or Figma link. It’ll take care of the styling.

options.B: No... Only if you restyle every slide
options.C: Just share your brand file or Figma link

QUIZ-24.text: Want your brand’s colors in your Halloween deck? How can Okou help?

QUIZ-25.explanation: Describe the subject and style. Okou creates an illustration for your idea.
QUIZ-25.text: Need a Halloween illustration? What can Okou create for you?

QUIZ-26.explanation: A matching series? Piece of cake for Okou.

options.B: A whole set in the same style
options.C: Only a mood board for you to follow

QUIZ-26.text: Need a matching set of Halloween illustrations? What can Okou create for you?

QUIZ-27.explanation: Send the reference image and describe the result you want. Okou can work from it.

options.A: Only a description of the image
options.B: Only a copy of the original
options.C: A new illustration using it as a reference

QUIZ-27.text: Have a Halloween image you like? What can Okou create for you?

QUIZ-28.explanation: Preview the image, then download it to use wherever you need it.

options.A: A preview and a downloadable file

QUIZ-28.text: When Okou makes an image, what do you get?

QUIZ-29.explanation: Analysis, charts, and a polished layout—Okou brings the whole report together.
QUIZ-29.text: What can Okou put in your spooky campaign report?

QUIZ-30.explanation: Give Okou the new data or use a connected source. It can update the report without you rebuilding it by hand.

options.A: No—you have to rebuild it each time
options.B: Only if you edit every number yourself
options.C: Yes—ask it to update it with the new data

QUIZ-30.text: New data just came in. Can Okou update your existing report?

QUIZ-31.explanation: Share the link with access enabled. They can open the report right in their browser.
QUIZ-31.text: How can others view your Okou Halloween report?

QUIZ-32.explanation: From copy to design to a live link—Okou gets your site ready for visitors.

options.B: A finished site with a shareable link

QUIZ-32.text: Your Halloween launch needs a site. What can Okou deliver?

QUIZ-33.explanation: Phone or laptop, Okou adapts the layout to fit the screen.

options.A: Tiny text. Hope they brought a magnifier.
options.B: A giant page. Swipe, swipe, swipe.
options.C: A layout that fits their screen

QUIZ-33.text: Someone opens your Okou site on a phone. What do they see?

QUIZ-34.explanation: Say “Turn this report into a deck.”

options.A: Nope. Time to copy and paste.
options.B: Only if you switch to another tool
options.C: Yes—just ask it to make it a deck

QUIZ-34.text: Can Okou turn the report it made into a presentation?

QUIZ-35.explanation: Type @Okou where your team is talking. That’s your summoning spell.
QUIZ-35.text: How do you summon Okou in a Slack thread?

QUIZ-36.explanation: @Okou in a channel for teamwork, or DM it to work on a draft privately!

options.A: Only in a channel—no DMs allowed
options.B: In a channel or a DM

QUIZ-36.text: Where can you find Okou in Slack?

QUIZ-37.explanation: Open Okou on the web. The same thread keeps the full run log and files together.

options.B: On the web, but only if you start over
options.C: The same thread is on the web, too

QUIZ-37.text: A long Okou run started in Slack. Where else can you see the full process?

options.B: It already has access to every app
options.C: Just by knowing the app names

QUIZ-38.text: How does Okou connect to your work apps?

QUIZ-39.explanation: Choose what Okou can access and for how long. You’re in control.

QUIZ-40.explanation: Share the workflow, not your account access. Everyone uses their own permissions—keep yours private.
QUIZ-40.text: Your teammate runs a workflow you shared. Whose connected apps does it use?

QUIZ-41.explanation: If the tool has an API, a custom connector may bring it into Okou—even an internal tool.
QUIZ-41.text: Your team’s tool isn’t in Okou’s connector list. Is that game over?

QUIZ-42.explanation: With your approval, Okou can file the GitHub issue. While you’re there, give Okou a star!

options.A: Just explain what a bug is
options.B: File a GitHub issue with the details

QUIZ-42.text: You found a bug that’s scarier than Halloween. How can Okou help track it?

QUIZ-43.explanation: Describe your ideal customer. How many you want, how many you get.

options.B: Sort a list you already have

QUIZ-43.text: Your sales pipeline is a ghost town. Which Okou result gives you new prospects to evaluate?

QUIZ-44.explanation: Share the latest updates. Okou can keep everything together in one Google Sheet!

options.B: A contact list with names only

QUIZ-44.text: You need to track each collab contact’s status and next step. What should you ask Okou to create?

QUIZ-45.explanation: Okou won’t send this email without your say-so. You get the final call.

options.A: Okou—it goes out as soon as it’s done
options.B: You—you review it and hit Send
options.C: Your team admin—every draft needs approval

QUIZ-45.text: Okou drafts your collab email. Who gets the final say before it’s sent?

QUIZ-46.explanation: Click Get more credits at the top right of chat to see your available tasks and requirements.

options.B: In Artifacts, next to your files

QUIZ-46.text: Looking for extra Okou credits? Where are the reward tasks?

QUIZ-47.explanation: Just tell Okou. It’s here to be your best AI teammate.

options.A: Just tell it—it’ll get the idea
options.B: It should know everything, even if you say nothing

QUIZ-47.text: Want Okou to get your work style? What helps most?

QUIZ-48.explanation: Confidence isn’t evidence. Okou can help you check sources and separate facts from assumptions.

options.C: Yes, if the answer is long enough

QUIZ-48.text: An AI sounds confident. Is that proof it’s right?

QUIZ-49.explanation: First the data, then the answer. Okou will ask for what’s missing, not invent it.

options.A: Pick a number that sounds right
options.B: Say “A lot!” and call it a day
options.C: Ask for the sales data first

QUIZ-49.text: “Okou, how much did we sell?” What should it do without the sales data?

QUIZ-50.explanation: Skip the blank-page panic. Give Okou the brief and let it do the research and writing—you review the plan.
QUIZ-50.text: Your boss wants a Halloween campaign plan “by yesterday.” How can Okou help?

QUIZ-51.explanation: You set the direction. Okou helps get the work done. Still your team, still your call.
QUIZ-51.text: With Okou handling the work, what’s your role?

QUIZ-52.explanation: OMG, you actually got it! You’re a true Okou pro.
QUIZ-52.text: What do you type in Okou’s chat box to open the template menu? (Hardest question. No pressure.)

QUIZ-53.explanation: Oh cool. Okou likes you too!

availability.text: The Halloween quiz is available whenever it appears in Okou. If the activity becomes unavailable, your saved round stays intact and can be resumed when it appears again.
availability.title: Activity availability

play.text: Play from your signed-in Okou account, with no tasks required. Each round is saved directly to that account and has four randomly selected questions, with no repeats in that round, followed by ‘Do you like Okou?’—every answer to the last question is correct. One wrong answer ends the round. Closing or refreshing the quiz keeps your current progress or result. Choose ‘Play again’ after a result to start a new round.
play.title: How to play

reward.text: Selected participants receive seven calendar days of Okou Pro access. No credits are included. Existing credit balances and normal usage limits still apply. Winning the game or completing optional tasks does not guarantee a reward. Both successful and unsuccessful rounds can be reviewed. Each account can receive at most one reward; existing Pro access is extended by seven days. A new trial starts when granted; that local date counts as day one, and access expires at 12:00 AM seven local dates later. For example, a reward granted October 30 expires November 6 at 12:00 AM in Los Angeles.
reward.title: Your Halloween reward

support.text: Rounds are recorded against the Okou account currently signed in. Eligibility is reviewed by the Okou team using participant lists collected during and after the event. Accounts included in a collected list and reviewed will receive an email, whether selected or not; an email is not promised to every participant. No fixed review or delivery date is promised. Questions? Contact support@okou.ai. Okou reserves the right of final interpretation of these rules to the extent permitted by applicable law.
support.title: Fair play & support
